name: The Way We All Go
source:
The Way We All Go is a hybrid horror/romance visual novel in which you play as ‘Atcchan’, a teenage boy shorter than the rest of his peers, who is only ever addressed by his childhood nickname.

It’s been two years since he left his hometown; a small, sleepy village with a tiny population. Now, he is finally able to return – but only for three days. How will his old friends react to him, and how will their relationships change…?

For a person who’s always been afraid of change, this is a worrying prospect for our hero… but it’s something he will have to overcome if he can ever hope to right his past wrongs and regain the trust of his friends. And a failure to do so can result in some rather unpleasant outcomes…

[From [url=http://ebi-hime.tumblr.com/post/89672447171/the-way-we-all-go-dl]official site[/url]]
translation:
《The Way We All Go》是一部混合恐怖/浪漫的视觉小说，你在其中扮演“Atcchan”，一个比其他同龄人矮的十几岁男孩，人们只用他童年时的昵称来称呼他。

离开家乡已经两年了；一个人口稀少、昏昏欲睡的小村庄。现在，他终于可以回来了——但只有三天。他的老朋友们会对他有何反应，他们的关系又会发生怎样的变化……？

对于一个一直害怕改变的人来说，这对我们的英雄来说是一个令人担忧的前景……但如果他希望纠正过去的错误并重新获得朋友的信任，那么他就必须克服这一点。如果不这样做可能会导致一些相当不愉快的结果……

[来自[url=http://ebi-hime.tumblr.com/post/89672447171/the-way-we-all-go-dl]官方网站[/url]]
